# Hachisu

Hachisu is a non-custodial Bitcoin payment application for merchants and small
businesses. It is a merchant tool for taking payment, not a consumer wallet.

Note on the name: "Hachisu" is also a Japanese surname and appears as an
unrelated personal name, business name and fictional character elsewhere on the
web. This file describes the Bitcoin payments product at https://hachisu.io/
only.

## What it does

- Accept Bitcoin payments from customers, in person or online
- Create invoices for a specific amount and share a payment link
- Send reusable payment requests and track whether they were paid
- Run a point of sale, either from a product list or as a one-off charge
- Provide a pay button for an existing checkout
- Track store activity and export monthly statements

## Custody

Hachisu is non-custodial. Merchants connect their own Bitcoin wallet and
payments settle directly to it. Hachisu does not hold, control or transmit
merchant Bitcoin, and has no access to private keys or recovery phrases.

## What it supports today

- Currency: Bitcoin only. Hachisu is not a general cryptocurrency platform.
- Settlement: on-chain Bitcoin.
- Lightning: not currently available to merchants.
- Platform: a mobile app for iPhone.
- Availability: in development, not yet released on the App Store.

## Canonical website

https://hachisu.io/

Supporting domains hachisu.app and hachisubitcoin.com redirect here and are not
separate products.
